summary: RETEST after axios FormData Content-Type fix. Both PRIMARY (ImageReplaceModal upload) and SECONDARY (AddProduct upload) flows now upload successfully to Cloudinary via the shared axios api client. Full end-to-end flow verified including product PATCH persistence and thumbnail refresh.
action_items: Optional: The Puma Tshirt product image was changed during testing. Final image URL: https://res.cloudinary.com/q42puvi7/image/upload/v1784801826/storex/products/fq7mfklwjyw9x1sy82l6.jpg — main agent may want to normalize/restore if needed.

Minor (not blocking): 'Uploaded to Cloudinary' toast text was not detected in body a few seconds after upload (toasts auto-dismiss in ~2s, so this is expected — success was verified via 201 response and cloudinary preview render).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/client/src/services/api.js request interceptor (delete Content-Type when body instanceof FormData) is correct and unblocks all multipart uploads through the shared axios client.

ProductList row-level Edit/Save/Cancel buttons lack data-testid attributes (only replace-image-{id} exists). Recommend adding edit-product-{id}, save-product-{id}, cancel-product-{id} for more robust E2E tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded 2 Cloudinary assets and updated Puma Tshirt product image URL to fq7mfklwjyw9x1sy82l6.jpg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Axios FormData interceptor fix works. POST /api/admin/upload returns 201 with cloudinary secure_url. Modal image-modal-save enables after picking; row Save triggers PATCH /api/admin/products/{id} returning 200 with 'Product updated' toast. AddProduct upload-image-input also works and populates Selected Images.

regression.console_errors: One benign ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED (unrelated), no app JS errors
